name: commonforge
description: Create, check out and submit CommonForge tasks from Claude.
long_description: Work with a CommonForge project from Claude: sign in with a one-time code from the CommonForge app, list your projects and tasks, ask for a change in plain words, and, in an agent with access to your files, check a task out, do the work and submit it. Everything goes through your CommonForge server, which checks your role on every request, exactly as the cforge CLI does.
